dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So you have seen the Belyi Tsar before, then?

dialogues.speaker: Ovsyannikov
dialogues.text: Of cour—— While I've never laid eyes on him myself, but my elders all had ties to the nobility in one way or another. They all served under the banner of the Tsar at some point in their lives!

dialogues.speaker: Ovsyannikov
dialogues.text: Why, do you not believe me? Just look at these markings on my own person! Do you honestly think that's something every stray dog out there walks around with?
